An AI assistant built right into TAGRA III
TAGRA III is the first TAGRA with a built-in AI assistant. Open it from any screen and ask in your own words — about using the program, drivers' hours, working time or tachograph rules.
TAGRA III tells the assistant which window you opened it from, so the answer fits what you are doing.
The assistant answers in the language TAGRA III is set to.
TAGRA III does not send drivers' personal data to the assistant. AI answers may contain mistakes — check important decisions against the regulation or with our support.
TAGRA III – Digital Tachograph Software for Fleet Operators

TAGRA III is digital tachograph software for fleets — driver card and vehicle data, infringements with cited regulations, EU drivers' hours, AETR and working time under Directive 2002/15/EC and national rules.

TAGRA III — digital tachograph software for fleet operators, 1 to unlimited vehicles. Loads driver card and vehicle unit data, evaluates Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, AETR, Directive 2002/15/EC and national rules (CZ, SK, HU), cites the regulation for every infringement and shows a task overview of downloads, card expiry and calibration. Data stored locally. Free 30-day trial. Ready for vans from July 2026.
Purchase price includes the first year of updates and support. An annual fee of €19–€149 applies from year 2 to keep the software active.

Drivers' hours under Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 and the AETR agreement, records under Regulation (EU) No 165/2014, and working time under Directive 2002/15/EC. National working-time rules are built in for the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Hungary; elsewhere working time is evaluated under the directive. Each infringement shows the cited article, the wording of the regulation and a recommendation.

Everything happens directly inside the software. At the end of the trial — or whenever you're ready — open the licence menu, select the version that matches your number of vehicles (TAGRA 1, 2, 4, 6 or MAX), and pay online. Payment is made by QR code or online transfer. Your licence is issued and activated immediately — you continue working in the same environment with all your data intact. New: you can now order licences, download devices and money-saving bundles directly online in the TAGRA Shop.

TAGRA is tachograph analysis software designed for any transport operator required to perform driver card download, evaluation and archiving — from sole traders with one vehicle to large fleets with hundreds of vehicles. Choose the version that matches your number of vehicles: TAGRA 1, 2, 4, 6 or MAX (unlimited).

Data is loaded from the driver card (via a card reader or download key) and from the tachograph unit. TAGRA supports both manual loading via DOWNLOAD BOX II S and tachograph remote download through DOWNLOAD BOX REMOTE or DKV LIVE® integration.
Driver cards at least every 28 days and the tachograph unit at least every 90 days. Downloaded data must be kept for a minimum of 1 year.

Tachograph data is most commonly stored as .DDD files. Some countries also use .C1B (driver card) and .V1B or ESM (vehicle). These files cannot be opened with a standard viewer — you need dedicated tachograph analysis software like TAGRA for proper digital tachograph analysis.

The annual fee covers continued licensing, software updates and technical support. The first year is included in the purchase price; from year 2 the fee is €19/year (TAGRA Trucker), €29/year (TAGRA TRUCKER 2), €79/year (TAGRA 1–2), €99/year (TAGRA 4–6), or €149/year (TAGRA MAX), all excl. VAT.
